apiContracts: Collections are private by default; public listing includes only public collections.
All collection mutations require an authenticated session and are scoped to session u.id.
Private collection detail is indistinguishable from not-found to non-owners.
Only published novels with original, public_domain, licensed or authorized rights status may be added or projected.
A reader may own at most 50 collections; each collection may contain at most 100 novels.
Database uniqueness prevents duplicate novel membership within a collection.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: New normalized collection and collection-item entities; foreign keys cascade on owner, collection and novel deletion.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Additive numbered D1 migration; no existing reader, novel, or chapter records are rewritten.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Do not drop collection tables after deployment. Revert application routes if required and preserve reader-created collection data for a forward repair.

uiLifecycle.ssrBehavior: No SSR changes in this backend slice.
uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: Community page renders authenticated owner management and public collection discovery; collection detail supports opening, item removal for owners, visibility changes, edits and deletion. Novel detail provides an authenticated add-to-collection flow.
uiLifecycle.servedBundleParity: public/app.js and public/app-17.23.0.js are byte-identical; collection UI regression test enforces parity.

privacySecurity.authentication: Collection creation, mutation and private listing require the existing authenticated session.
privacySecurity.authorization: Every write scopes collection owner_user_id to session u.id; delete-item SQL rechecks owner in the mutation predicate.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Client-supplied owner IDs are ignored. Private collection detail returns 404 to non-owners.
privacySecurity.csrf: Existing Worker write-route Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site policy remains in force.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Title 80 characters, description 500 characters, 50 collections per owner and 100 novels per collection.
privacySecurity.rightsAndPrivacy: Public collection contents are filtered to published and rights-eligible novels; no chapter bodies or private user details are exposed.

integration: Community page and novel-detail UI contract verifies authenticated create/manage/add flows and public collection discovery.
isolation: Two-account Worker/D1 test proves private collection listing and detail isolation.
Non-owner cannot edit or delete a collection or mutate its items.
Only published rights-eligible novels may be added or publicly projected.
D1 triggers reject the 51st collection and 101st item under concurrent-safe database enforcement.

stagingSteps: Run all repository CI checks on the exact PR head.
Apply migration 0048 to a fresh local D1 database.
Add two-account Worker/D1 integration tests before runtime certification.
Verify Community Collections UI on mobile and desktop with guest, owner and non-owner sessions; verify all 14 locale dictionaries and source/served bundle parity.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert collection route composition and module code if needed; do not delete user data tables.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: Preserve additive collection rows; repair forward with a new migration if schema correction is needed.

changeSummary: Adds D1-backed private-by-default reader collections with owner-scoped CRUD, rights-eligible novel membership, database-enforced quotas, a localized Community collection interface, novel-detail add flow, and integration regression coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration 0048 applies cleanly to a fresh D1 database.
Private collections are never visible to non-owners.
Collection mutation always binds to the authenticated owner.
Only published rights-eligible novels may be added or projected.
Duplicate membership and configured collection limits are enforced.
API route inventory and Worker source fingerprints match the exact PR source.
Two-account local Worker/D1 integration proves private collection isolation and owner-only mutations.
D1-compatible SQLite integration proves owner and item quotas, duplicate membership and cascading deletion.
Community page exposes create, own collection management, public collection discovery and collection detail views.
Novel detail page offers an authenticated add-to-collection action and handles empty collection state.
Versioned served browser bundle is byte-identical to public/app.js.
Community page exposes create/manage own collections and browse public collections; private controls remain session-gated.
Collection detail supports public viewing and owner-only item removal; novel detail supports authenticated add-to-collection.
Collection interface localization covers all 14 supported locales and served browser bundle matches source.
